rows.grounds: compound taila + stha; fused accusative adjective

items.question: What ritual placement of the circle-king in oil produces supreme hostility?
premises: Circle-king placed in oil causes hostility.
The rite belongs to night worship.
items.inference: The oil-immersed circle-king is the supreme hostility-causing rite.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of cakrarāja remains unresolved.
items.plain_english: But the circle-king standing in oil is indeed the supreme cause of hostility.
